rules.note: SPEC §2.8. One pick earned per summer, spent on one stat. Unused picks carry over up to a cap. Blocks are the flavour a stat belongs to, not the unit of choice. A pick buys one attribute step and nothing else — it is not a currency.
rules.curveNote: The gain is a single definite figure per season, shown before the choice — not a range. It is largest while a player is young and smallest once they are past their peak, which is where the tapering used to be invisible. Seasons are inclusive `from`..`to`; the last band runs to the end of the career.

blocks.name: Gym Block
blocks.description: Eight weeks under the bar with the strength and conditioning staff. You come back thicker through the chest and harder to move at the collision.
blocks.flavour: Nobody enjoys it. Everybody notices it in September.

blocks.name: Fitness Camp
blocks.description: Altitude, hill runs and a heart-rate monitor that never lies. The last twenty minutes of a match stop being someone else's problem.
blocks.flavour: You will hate every morning of it and thank yourself in round eighteen.

blocks.name: Tactical Film
blocks.description: Whole days in the analysis room with the coaches, picking apart set piece, exit plays and where the space actually is.
blocks.flavour: The game slows down for players who have already seen it.

blocks.name: Skills Session
blocks.description: Handling drills until the ball stops being a decision, footwork grids, and technique over the ball at the breakdown.
blocks.flavour: Small margins, repeated ten thousand times.
